workflow: exactly eight declared artifacts: weights, config, tokenizer, loader_ref, data_provenance, license, evaluation, and sha256sums
recompute every declared SHA-256 under the bounded artifact-byte budget
run one manifest-declared loader with a bounded timeout
emit JSON plus a static HTML receipt
acceptance: PASS only when all eight required artifact names appear exactly once, every artifact SHA-256 matches, and the loader exits zero
a missing path, changed byte, unsupported artifact scheme, path escape, timeout, or loader error fails the receipt at the exact stage
local artifact paths and loader cwd remain inside the manifest directory
remote artifact reads are limited to HTTP or HTTPS
artifact bytes are capped at 10 MiB total and loader runtime is capped at 60 seconds
the verifier invokes the manifest-declared loader but does not attest or prevent that loader's filesystem, network, database, training, or publication side effects

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: one buyer-supplied release manifest and its referenced artifact bytes; local paths remain inside the manifest directory; remote artifact reads are HTTP(S) only; 10 MiB total artifact cap; the manifest-declared loader may perform side effects outside the receipt's assurance
decision_boundary: binary release-completeness verification only: eight artifact digests plus one manifest-declared loader exit; the receipt does not attest or prevent loader side effects and does not itself publish the release
